Onboarding.metaTitle: Start preparing for Umrah · Umra Hub
Onboarding.title: Let's set up your Umrah trip
Onboarding.intro: Answer 5 short questions so your preparation checklist fits your group. Nothing is saved until you tap Create my trip.

city.title: Departure city
city.hint: Which city will you fly from?

date.title: Approximate travel date
date.hint: Pick a month and year; an estimate is fine.

passport.title: Passport status
passport.hint: What is the state of your group's passports right now?

travelers.title: Travelers
travelers.hint: Enter the name of everyone travelling, including you.

needs.title: Special needs
needs.hint: Mark travelers who need extra care so their preparation is adjusted.

errors.date: Choose a month and year within the next 24 months.
errors.names: Enter a name for every traveler (1–80 characters).
errors.notes: Notes can be up to 500 characters.
errors.invalid: Some answers aren't valid. Please check them and try again.
errors.failed: Couldn't create your trip. Please try again.
errors.limit: You already have 10 trips. Delete one to create a new one.

Notifications.title: Notifications
Notifications.intro: Deadline reminders for your Umrah preparation.
Notifications.empty: No notifications yet. Reminders appear here as your departure date gets closer.

3_6_months_before.title: 3–6 months before departure
3_6_months_before.body: Time to sort out your passport and meningitis vaccine, and start saving for your Umrah.

2_3_months_before.title: 2–3 months before departure
2_3_months_before.body: Time to book flights and a hotel for your Umrah.

1_month_before.title: 1 month before departure
1_month_before.body: Time to exchange riyals, buy ihram clothing and study the Umrah rituals (manasik).

1_week_before.title: 1 week before departure
1_week_before.body: Time to check all your documents and confirm your flight and hotel bookings.

departure_day.title: Departure is tomorrow
departure_day.body: Time for a final check of your luggage and the documents in your carry-on. Have a blessed Umrah.
